summary: Woori Financial Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 third-quarter earnings release conference, scheduled for Friday, October 23, 2026 at 16:00 Korea Time, with agenda limited to quarterly results and a Q&A session. The event is a live audio webcast and conference call in Korean and English with simultaneous interpretation, accessible via the company website and a pre-registration dial-in passcode 312285. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the schedule is subject to change. This is a routine earnings-notice filing with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
